svg.aria-label: Sketch: the terminal at Erbil International Airport in Iraqi Kurdistan, seen from across the city under a hazy sky. A long dark glass terminal block carries six pointed white canopy shells along its front, each junction resting on a slender V strut, with a round drum-shaped building at its left end; a line of parked cars and a row of small trees run along the road in front. Below it stands a long white hangar with a curved roof, then a boundary wall, a row of flat-roofed sheds with satellite dishes, a small truck and a lattice crane at right. A low ridge of hills with scattered buildings fades into haze along the horizon. No people in the scene.
